title: Queen's Domain review
text:
Where to start with Queen's Domain? It's tempting to begin with King's Field; after all, FromSoftware's seminal first-person action-RPG is an explicit inspiration for developer Freshly Baked Games. But 40 hours later, it feels like so much more. It's equally tempting to invoke another FromSoftware game: Dark Souls. Queen's Domain owes an obvious debt to that game's celebrated level design: the dazzling interconnectedness of its vertiginous world. But that's not quite right either. The deeper you delve, the more there's something of the spirit of The Legend of Zelda, a touch of Metroidvania too. Until finally you concede that Queen's Domain, with its remarkable world of densely packed secrets, is very much its own.

title: Rockstar Games Has A GTA 6 Hit On Its Hands, But Its Union Vote Is A Loss
text:
Roughly 75% of Rockstar Games staff in the UK have voted against a formal recognition agreement with the Independent Workers' Union of Great Britain (IWGB). The news came in the wake of GTA 6's record-breaking launch, and had the IWGB been recognized, Rockstar Games management would have been legally obligated to negotiate collective bargaining terms with the union on topics such as pay, hours, and conditions.

Voting took place across two weeks, and turnout was massive, with over 93% of UK staff casting their ballot (roughly 1,544 employees). The IWGB said it was undeterred by the result and would continue working to build support among Rockstar employees. "While the result means Rockstar will not be formally required to hold regular meetings with union representatives under a recognition agreement, it does not prevent workers from continuing to organize and push for workplace improvements through the IWGB, joining the union or exercising their individual trade union rights and protections," the union said in a statement.

The vote also comes hot on the heels of the IWGB taking Rockstar to an employment tribunal, alleging unlawful dismissal and union busting after it fired over 30 employees last year for gross misconduct over alleged leaks of confidential information. Closing submissions were wrapped up shortly before the vote results came out, and a ruling is still pending. While game dev unionizing has gained significant momentum over the years, a decisive loss at one of the industry's biggest studios could be a notable speed bump for union organizers.

With Rockstar also riding the wave of GTA 6's monumental success, employees may be focused on bonuses and post-launch momentum, which could make pushing through a formal union structure even harder. "For anyone at Rockstar who believes in a fairer workplace, a fairer sector and a fairer society--this isn't a sign to retreat; it's a sign to double down on what we stand for. Hundreds of our coworkers voted in favor of our union at Rockstar, yet sadly we recognize we have more work to do to build understanding and win the trust of more of our colleagues,' the IWGB added.

title: GTA 6’s Furry Rescue Mission Is A Little Weird, But The Rewards Are Worth It
text:
No matter what you do in GTA 6, it pales in comparison to being a Furry in that game. Anyone looking to externalize their inner animal spirit is in danger of being hunted, and you'll find out for yourself just how much the fictional state of Leonida hates Furries when you're given the chance to save one of them from being murdered by the cops. Should you help them? Absolutely, if you want an easy payday or a new weapon for your arsenal.

How to find Chase the Fox

Like several other missions in GTA 6, helping out the Furry resistance appears to trigger randomly. The mission takes place after Chapter 3, on Miramar Drive in Crosstown, Vice City, and you'll want to be cruising around that area at night, between midnight and 4 AM.

Once it starts, you'll see cops pull up to hunt down a Furry by the name of Chase, and if you drive up to him, you can either give him a lift or leave him to his brutal fate.

Outrun the cops

If you do choose to help Chase, then get ready to be hunted down by cops. You'll pick up a three-star Wanted level, which means the cops will be in mildly hot pursuit of your vehicle.

Reach the parking garage

Chase will direct you to a nearby parking garage, where his Furry allies are waiting. After a short standoff, they'll welcome you into their ranks as an honorary Furry.

Courier the group to safety

To get the law off your polyester tail, one of your new allies will take your car and use it to distract the cops. Get inside the van, and you can bring the other Furries home to their swanky pad in Starfish Island. While you're driving, the Furries will interact with each other, and you can watch their hijinks.

Choose your reward

Once Chase and his pals are back home, you'll be offered one of two rewards: $15,000 in cash or the unique Furry DW-9 submachine gun. Personally, I'd go with the gun since it's easy enough to make cash in GTA 6, and having more weapons is never a bad idea. You'll also gain safehouse access to the Furry group's hideout, where you can stock up on weapons and body armor.

For more on GTA 6, from completing side missions to finding a tricky location on the sprawling map of Leonida, we’ve got you covered with our Grand Theft Auto 6 guides hub.

title: Mario, Pikachu, And Other Gaming Icon Balloons Won’t Be Flying This Thanksgiving
text:
New York City is no stranger to bad weather, be it blazing-hot summers, snow-packed winters, or fierce windstorms. Unfortunately for countless families who have made it a holiday tradition to turn on the TV and watch giant totems of pop culture sail in the streets of the great city, the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade has been officially delayed due to a forecast of rain and windstorms--a first in its 100-year history.

In recent years, gaming icons have become more and more prominent during the parade. Beginning in 1993, a balloon of Sonic the Hedgehog marked the first game character to float among the procession. Since then, more characters have joined the festivities, including Mario, Pac-Man, Pikachu, and even Red the Angry Bird, among others.

However, those who have followed the history of Macy's balloons know that the mix of bad weather and massive, floating objects can result in genuine danger for balloon handlers, bystanders, and objects on the streets. Other balloon bursts have proved even more catastrophic, with a series of mishaps in 1997 leading to a Cat in the Hat balloon causing injuries that left a woman comatose for days. Since then, more emphasis has rightfully been put on safety.

While it might be disappointing to not be able to point at the TV and go "Mario!" with your younger cousins around the TV tomorrow, the balloons will get a chance to fly on Saturday starting at 8:30 AM ET, when the weather is likely to be significantly less awful. title: Three Years After His Death, EA Is Using AI To Bring Back A Famed Commentator In FC 27
text:
EA Sports FC 27 is adding an AI-generated commentator for the first time in the series' history, with famed British commentator John Motson having his voice synthesized for the football title.

Motson, who passed way in 2023, previously provided commentary for EA's FIFA series, appearing in the game's first iteration in 1996 and featuring until 2005. According to the BBC, EA approached Motson's wife and son for permission to regenerate his voice and use his likeness for this year's entry in the series. Both agreed to the idea, but neither party has disclosed how much EA has paid for the use. Fred Motson, John's son, stated that he believed his father would've approved of this use of AI.

"My dad was the least technological person in the world," Fred stated. "Till his dying day, he had a typewriter on his desk. So I don't think he would have quite understood what the AI was doing technologically, but I think, on the other hand, he was always really keen to get involved in these kinds of projects."

Peter Caulfield, founder of Save Our Voices Now, which campaigns against this exact use of AI, questions whether a family should be able to provide consent for someone who can no longer give it themselves. "If someone has signed a deal allowing their likeness to be used after they die, I have no issue with that," he explained. "But in life or in death, unless you have specifically agreed to it, AI cloning of any kind should not be allowed. Being a family member shouldn't automatically give you that right either."

This isn't new to video games, either. Epic Games used a similar method to bring back the late James Earl Jones' voice for its Star Wars event in Fortnite, with the actor's estate agreeing to the use. It allowed players to converse with the AI bot while playing, and was very quickly removed after some users managed to get the bot to spew out racist or vulgar phrases, all delivered with the voice of Jones. It also drew the ire of SAG-AFTRA, which claimed that Epic had violated labor practices.

Derek Rae, one of the currently employed commentators on EA Sports FC 27, said he was excited by the inclusion of Motson's voice, and that he didn't believe AI was yet going to replace his own work on the game. When asked whether he would make the same decision to have his work endure for years to come through AI, he replied, "I'm hopefully many years away from having to make a decision like that."

title: Diablo 4’s Most Nostalgic Season Is Becoming (Mostly) Permanent
text:
Diablo 4 is gearing up for the arrival of Season 16, but it won't be leaving its popular previous season behind entirely.

As detailed by Blizzard in a breakdown of the upcoming Season of Tyrael's Gambit, much of the previous season, Hell's Legacy, will become a permanent part of Diablo 4 going forward. Season 15 served as celebration of the franchise's history, and added a smorgasbord of items and callbacks to previous Diablo titles, including a storyline revolving around Deckard Cain and the return of enemies and boss encounters from Diablo 2. 

Most of that is carrying forward, Blizzard said. Due to "overwhelming requests" from the game's community, Blizzard outlined what all from Hell's Legacy will survive.

Hell's Legacy's capstone dungeons will be added, as will the ability to summon a World Boss version of Diablo and take on the cow god Moopisto. The Prime Evil Council is also becoming permanent, and will work the same way the game's other Lair bosses do, with players needing a specific item to open their reward chest after successfully defeating the encounter.

Waking Nightmare dungeons will still be accessible, but only by finding Chronicle of Nightmares dungeon keys. Monsters from previous Diablo games will also have a chance to spawn in The Pit. Those who progressed their secret cow level journey can also rejoice, as the secret cow island and its corresponding waypoint will be staying.

Many of Hell's Legacy's best items were new versions of classics from older Diablo games, and those Legacy Uniques will be added permanently as well, including the Annihilus Seal and Hellfire Torch Charm.

That's all for now, but Blizzard said more of Hell's Legacy could make a return in the future.

"Other popularly requested features are being evaluated for rework and may appear in the future," Blizzard said.

Diablo 4 Season 16 launches December 1. In addition to bringing forward much of Hell's Legacy, Tyrael's Gambit will additionally overhaul the game's War Plans system and make its Helltide activity easier.

Diablo 4 won't receive new expansions going forward, but it is receiving a new class, the Amazon, next year. Blizzard is also hard at work on Diablo 5. Though it's not slated to arrive until 2029, Blizzard has already revealed three of Diablo 5's playable classes and promised it will launch with more class options than any previous Diablo game.

title: Another Live-Service Game Is Going Extinct, And This One Has Dinosaurs
text:
Capcom has had a big year, but amid the hits comes news that its Overwatch-with-dinosaurs game, Exoprimal, will join the live-service graveyard next year. The game's servers will go offline next year, making it unplayable after that.

"Thank you so much for your continued use of Exoprimal, a statement on the Exoprimal site reads. "We regret to announce that service for Exoprimal will be discontinued as of Thursday, September 30, 2027. We cannot thank you enough for the love and support you have shown over the years, and we sincerely apologize for the gravity of this announcement."

Exoprimal season passes are no longer available to purchase through storefronts, and Capcom will slowly wind down the game over several months. Exoprimal and all its DLC will be delisted from stores starting March 30, 2027, but anyone who owns it can still download and play it before the September 2027 deadline. Despite a cool premise and fun gameplay, Exoprimal never truly took off after its 2023 launch.

"While Exoprimal’s early hours of repetitive and simple missions will likely drive some people away, its later surprises are a delight for those willing to give it the necessary time," James Carr wrote in GameSpot's Exoprimal review. "The escalation of difficulty and the wide variety of objectives introduced later on in the shooter gives it fresh life several hours in. Fighting through an ocean of dinosaurs is a ton of fun, and the variety of enemies keeps you from falling into a repetitive combat loop."

The writing was already on the wall for Exoprimal in 2024, as Capcom announced it was ending seasonal updates and would rotate through existing content on a monthly schedule. While that doesn't reflect the entire player community, Exoprimal numbers have largely cratered on PC via Steam: it peaked at 4,9995 concurrent players in November 2023 and nosedived the following month. At the time of writing, Exoprimal's 24-hour peak was a paltry 23 players.

2026 has been merciless for live-service games, with several high-profile casualties. Developer Wildlight’s free-to-play shooter Highguard quickly lost momentum after its January launch, Anthem was sunset this year, and New World: Aeternum began winding down operations ahead of its January 2027 closure.

title: Why GTA 6 Doesn’t Let You Replay Missions–It Felt “Alien And Disconnected”
text:
One of the first things people noticed with Grand Theft Auto 6 is that you cannot replay missions, at least not in a simple, straightforward way. GTA 5 had a mission replay option, as did Red Dead Redemption II, so why doesn't GTA 6?

Senior design director Scott Butchard told Kotaku that Rockstar "certainly" considered a mission replay feature "early on in development." However, Butchard said, "As the game came together, it felt at odds with the story we were trying to tell and felt a bit alien and disconnected."

He went on to say replaying missions "really diminished the choices you had made."

While GTA 6 doesn't make it easy to replay missions, you still can do so by reloading an earlier GTA 6 save. Something else to know is that if you're in the middle of a mission and it's not going to plan, you can open the game menu and select retry, quit, or restart.

title: Diablo 4 Is Making Helltides A Hell Of A Lot Easier
text:
One of Diablo 4's oldest endgame activities, Helltides, is getting a major refresh for Season 16.

As detailed by developer Blizzard in their full breakdown of Season of Tyrael's Gambit, Helltides will soon be far more efficient to run than before. The whole point of the activity is to kill as many demons as fast as possible, acquire the Aberrant Cinders they drop, and then use those cinders to open chests for items.

Dying means losing half of the cinders you've collected, but they are also lost when the Helltide ends. Oftentimes that means having left over amounts of cinders you can't spend, only to then go to the next Helltide five minutes later and repeat the process from zero. It's been this way since Diablo 4 launched back in 2023.

In Season 16, that will finally change. Blizzard is getting rid of the downtime between Helltides spawning and making it so there will always be a Helltide up in one of the game's original zones, as well as one in expansion areas like Hahantu or Skovos. Even better, Aberrant Cinders won't be lost once a Helltide ends. Instead, players can collect up to 5,000 cinders at a time to be spent on opening chests within the activity. Additionally, the overall loot quality from opening chests in the Helltide will be improved and chests can be opened instantly.

Those changes should go a long way towards making Helltides feel more valuable and efficient when trying to farm gear, as you can now blast demons to your heart's content until reaching the Aberrant Cinder cap. Just don't die while you have a full 5,000 stored up. 

Diablo 4 Season 16 launches December 1. Alongside its Helltide changes, the season will bring big updates to War Plans as well. A new system, War Plans Tactics, will give players more control over what activities appear in their War Plans, as well as more options when it comes to rerolling them and the rewards they grant. Players will also have new Horadric items to chase that will modify specific Talisman sets, greatly increasing their power. 

Blizzard additionally announced many of the features that were added as part of Diablo 4 Season 15, Hell's Legacy, will be made permanent. Those additions include the season's capstone dungeons, optional bosses like Moophisto, the Annihilus Seal, Hellfire Torch Charm, and the season's legacy Unique items like Stone of Jordan.

title: GTA 6’s Mandy Actor Reacts To The Online “Weirdos”
text:
One of the most talked-about characters in GTA 6 outside of Jason and Lucia has been Mandy, a woman who tries to seduce Jason early in the game. She may also be a serial killer. The actor who plays Mandy, Lexie Shoaibi, has now discussed how she got the part and her reaction to people being weird online.

Speaking to Vulture, Shoaibi said she's able to see "more good than bad" thanks to her experience being a content creator.

"There are weirdos out there, and they’re going to try to bring you down, so it’s important to stay around the people and the places that aren’t doing that," she said. "It’s easy enough to do, which I’m very grateful for. There’s enough support in my real-life community and online that I can say, 'I could just hang out over here. I don’t actually need to go to the scary place.' I’m living in the positive, for sure."

People have been, to put it mildly, thirsting over Mandy since GTA 6 came out. However, Shoaibi had no idea she was going to be in GTA 6 at all because when she auditioned, she signed what she described as an "incredibly" strict NDA. In fact, she didn't even know what she was auditioning for.

Her commercial agent in New York brought it to her, and she thought it would be "just like any other commercial audition." From the time she auditioned until the game launched on November 19, Shoaibi did not know she was going to be in GTA 6. Instead, she did the audition and recorded her scenes for a project she knew as "Project Bubblegum."

Shoaibi said the notes she received included being told to play a “sexy ex-girlfriend" and to "be seductive.” 

When Shoaibi finally saw Mandy in GTA 6, she said it was "very exciting," in part because it meant that Rockstar didn't cut it. She did the recording for Mandy in 2023 or early 2024, Shoaibi said, and now that GTA 6 is finally here and her role as Mandy confirmed, Shoaibi said, "I feel like I'm living in a dream. It's crazy."

Shoaibi said she hopes her role as Mandy in the biggest video game ever can help grow her profile and get more jobs. "There’s definitely momentum that I wasn’t feeling before," she said.

title: Another Gaming Console Price Hike Could Be Coming, Thanks To New Tariffs
text:
The US government has announced a new round of tariffs targeting several major countries, including China, Japan, Vietnam, and European Union trading partners. Under the proposed tariffs, import taxes will rise significantly, with China facing up to 40% when the new duties take effect next year. According to the BBC, some of the rates will be reduced because of tariff caps that US President Donald Trump has already agreed to, and individual countries could also face different levies.

What does this mean for gaming hardware? Trump's first round of "Liberation Day" tariffs contributed to rising console prices, but the Supreme Court eventually struck them down. Big companies like Sony, Microsoft, and Nintendo benefited from tariff refunds after the ruling, but they didn't pass the savings on to consumers. In Sony's case, it was estimated to get back $508 million in refunds from the US government.

The new tariffs bypass the Supreme Court's ruling by using a different law, Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974, which allows the government to impose tariffs on countries that use unfair business practices. The law does require an investigation into specific trade practices before rates are set. If higher import taxes take effect, console companies could face much higher costs, and protecting their profits will likely mean consumers have to cover the difference.

Nintendo, Sony, and Microsoft have moved much of their final assembly out of China and into Southeast Asia, especially Vietnam, to avoid earlier tariffs. However, key parts like batteries and power supplies still mostly come from China, and if tariffs on these parts rise, total production costs for consoles made outside China will go up even more.

Some electronic goods could be exempt from tariffs, and manufacturers often stockpile inventory ahead of tariff deadlines to delay price changes. But with rising costs from the ongoing components shortage amid the AI boom and other global factors, console prices remain at risk. After the June announcement of steep console price hikes, Microsoft warned that Xbox console costs could rise again in 2027, and next-gen hardware is also expected to be very pricey.

title: Is GTA 6 Too Easy? Rockstar Weighs In
text:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here, and one of the things people are talking about is the game's difficulty level. Some are saying it's too easy. Rockstar boss Rob Nelson has now entered the conversation, telling Destructoid that Rockstar's data showed that GTA 4 was "a little too punishing in places" and GTA 5 was "perhaps too easy." So with GTA 6, the team trying to "land somewhere in the middle."

GTA 6 has no defined difficulty levels, which is in keeping with the franchise's tradition. That said, players can adjust things like aiming controls, while players can unlock cheat codes to make the game easier or harder.

Design producer Scott Mitchell, meanwhile, said the fail states in GTA 6 were designed to feel "appropriate."

“We wanted to keep things open and not limit the players’ use of mechanics, such as stealth, but we did also want to make sure we retained the cinematic, high production value, explosive sequences that we’re known for, and people expect. It feels like we’ve managed to strike a good balance," he explained.

Also in the interview, Nelson said figuring out the difficulty level for GTA 6 is itself challenging because the designers themselves know enemy positions better than anyone after playing and testing the game so much.

"There’s a real process in unpicking some of that to create an experience most players will be able to enjoy, rather than endure," Nelson said. "The game is so big, and has such a wide range of content that we can really lean into that, making certain open-world content--compounds and fronts for example---more difficult, to give players seeking a challenge something to sink their teeth into as well.”

title: GTA 6 Modders Are Trying To Vibe-Code A PC Port, And It’s Not Going Well
text:
PC modders are racing to get GTA 6 playable on PC after the leak of the game's complete Xbox build, but so far it doesn't look too promising.

GTA 6 publisher Take-Two Interactive and developer Rockstar Games haven't been sitting idle either, as one of the leads behind the Project Leonida Discord group claimed in now-deleted social media posts that they were stepping away from the mammoth task of getting GTA 6 to run on PC. Project Leonida has also been taken down, but it's not the only group trying to get GTA 6 running outside of PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

None of these groups have succeeded yet, and as Twitter user Chasm detailed online, maybe relying heavily on AI tools isn't the way to go. Dev streams have been full of users leveraging generative AI tools to do something, with several prompts being absolute gems of wishful thinking. Here's a snippet of what people have been throwing at Google's Antigravity, while butchering the English language:

  • Continue working and do apply ever part of the code
  • make no mistakes
  • You need todo one thing at a time not a little bit of everything
  • we need all the game start like the rockstar launch so on that stuff, not in game stuff yet
  • work faster
  • there has to be a faster way to iterate than this

Even with an army of enthusiasts throwing prompts and cash at generative AI, a copied version of GTA 6 still seems far out of reach. Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick commented in March that the idea of using AI and simply pushing a button to make a hit game was "laughable," and he referenced the music industry, which is grappling with a flood of AI slop to top streaming platforms. "Right now [in music] there are programs that allow you to put out a prompt and get a professionally recorded song spit back out at you. It sounds like a song, but I defy you to listen to it more than once. It's great to send as a greeting card to your partner on their birthday, but that's about it," Zelnick said.

Whatever progress is made in the GTA 6 PC port scene, don't expect it to last long before Take-Two's lawyers pounce. The publisher hasn't shied away from protecting its IP in the past, and takedown notices for any future GTA 6-related projects seem likely. title: The Witcher 4 Wants To Be The GTA 6 Of The Witcher Franchise
text:
There's been a massive gap between new entries in The Witcher series, and for The Witcher 4, developer CD Projekt Red aims to make it the GTA 6 of the series, with a noticeable leap in quality. In its Q3 earnings call, the studio says it has been inspired by the technological and gameplay advancements Rockstar Games has made with GTA 6--especially when compared to 2013's GTA 5--and hopes players will feel the same way when they jump into The Witcher 4.

"First of all, obviously this is a call about us, not about Rockstar," CDPR joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski (via Eurogamer). "But I do understand the connection here. Having said that, I'm not going to make a deep-dive and a full-blown review of GTA 5 versus GTA 6. But of course we did look at the game; we did see the differences. We believe there's going to be a comparable leap between The Witcher 3 and The Witcher 4--I think so, yes. It's been 11 years; we are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game, so yes, you should expect us to make a much bigger jump between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4."

When The Witcher 3: The Wild Hunt was first released in 2015, it was hailed for raising the bar for open-world adventure games. Its side-quests were singled out for being narratively dense, full of micro-consequences, and on par with the main campaign missions. In the years since, numerous open-world games have used The Witcher 3 as a blueprint, with notable examples being the Assassin's Creed trilogy of Origins, Odyssey, and Valhalla alongside Sony's Horizon Zero Dawn and Ghost of Tsushima.

Eleven years later, that bar has been raised again with GTA 6, which offers emergent, player-driven open-world chaos through multiple systems. The world of The Witcher is naturally very different from the consumerism-focused setting of GTA 6, but if The Witcher 4 builds on its predecessor's strengths and adds more nuance to those gameplay mechanics, we could be in for something special.

CDPR also said it's trying to make The Witcher 4 more appealing to mainstream audiences, but it hasn't detailed exactly how it plans to do that. "Our games are different, and they require a certain different approach--we just do things differently than they do. But in terms of the ultimate effect, in terms of breaking out to the mass market awareness: This is for sure something we consider pivotal to whatever we're going to do with our marketing campaigns in the future," Nowakowski said.

Currently, over 500 people are working on The Witcher 4, and CDPR has signed a marketing agreement with PlayStation for the game ahead of its targeted 2028 release. The studio is also chipping away at Cyberpunk 2, but after the launch of GTA 6, the game's creative director joked about canceling it, saying Rockstar's game set a high standard for open-world games.

title: WoW: Forever’s Best Buffs Now Work As Intended
text:
World of Warcraft: Forever players will now be able to get even more benefit from the game's strongest buffs, as developer Blizzard's latest hotfix has made World Buffs persist across loading screens as intended.

World Buffs are powerful stat-boosting effects granted to players in a particular area for certain events. The most common World Buff players see is Warchief's Blessing on the Horde and the new Might of Stormwind for the Alliance, which are granted to all players in Orgrimmar, Stormwind, and their surrounding low-level zones when players on their respective faction turn in a specific high-level quest.

Now that players are reaching endgame and turning in the required quest, these buffs are popping off constantly. They grant a whopping 300 hit points, 15% melee haste, and 10 mana regen per five seconds for one hour. At lower levels, those are some serious stats, particularly the 300 HP.

Unfortunately, players haven't been able to take full advantage of the buffs, as a bug was causing them to be lost when hitting a loading screen. That meant any time a group stepped into a dungeon or took a boat or zeppelin to a new location, their World Buffs would be removed.

That has finally been fixed in the latest update, so players can now enter dungeons with World Buffs to help maximize their damage and health. This should be particularly useful for doing dungeons at a slightly lower level than is intended, as the extra HP and melee haste is definitely noticable.

Blizzard clarified in the patch notes that World Buffs will still be removed when entering raids, so players won't be able to stack as many World Buffs as possible before raid night, as was the case in previous versions of classic WoW. 

Other changes found in the patch notes include a fix for an Uldaman boss that players were exploiting to make fast gold. Another is a fix for "a few spells and abilities" that were causing more weapon-proc effects than intended, likely nerfing the DPS of whatever classes were taking advantage of the bug. You can read the full patch notes below.

Blizzard recently outlined in the latest episode of the WoW: Forever podcast how it wants to get rid of the idea of "best-in-slot gear," as well as how the game's has overhauled old-school WoW's player-vs.-player systems. In other Forever news, the game's launch has seen more than 15 million characters created so far, with the highest weekly player numbers for WoW in 15 years.

title: Witcher 4 Has Fewer People Working On It Than It Did 3 Months Ago, But Just Barely
text:
As part of CD Projekt's latest earnings report, the Polish developer revealed new information about its projects and headcount.

For the quarter that ended on October 31, The Witcher 4 was the company's biggest project by headcount, with 513 people working on it. That's down from 519 people for the quarter that ended on July 31.

For comparison, the number of developers on Cyberpunk 2 rose from 184 to 199 and staffers on the new IP codenamed Hadar jumped from 33 to 34. The codename Sirius game, believed to be a multiplayer The Witcher game, saw its development staff shrink from 84 to 60; the project has undergone numerous shifts throughout its development as CD Projekt reworks the experience.

CD Projekt's total development headcount rose from 1,045 to 1,051.

In terms of money, CD Projekt reported Q3 revenue of 208 million PLN ($51 million USD) and net earnings of 109 million PLN ($26.8 million). CD Projekt spent a lot--more than 177 million PLN ($43.5 million) on development costs during the quarter--but the company's total cash reserves grew by 31 million PLN ($7.6 million USD).

CD Projekt has a number of big projects in the works, including The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past in 2027 and The Witcher 4 in 2028. Cyberpunk 2 is also on the way, but it doesn't have a release window yet. The company is also working on a game with Scopely, the mobile gaming giant owned by Saudi Arabia.

Cyberpunk 2 was in the news recently, as the game's creative director joked that the RPG is now canceled because GTA 6 is so good.

title: GTA 6 Is Giving Pornhub A Hard Time
text:
Not even porn is immune to the GTA 6 effect, as it's just one of several forms of entertainment that has seen a decline in viewership since the massive open-world game launched. It's not surprising, given the game's record-breaking start, with 32.5 million sales from preorders alone. On PS5, GTA 6 is the "biggest launch" in PlayStation history, and players spent an average of 17.4 hours playing in its first few days--which probably didn't leave much time for a quick browse of after-hours material.

According to Mashable, US traffic on Pornhub--which I've been told is one of the largest pornography websites, by traffic--dipped by as much as 15.5% an hour after GTA 6 launched. Paradoxically, Pornhub traffic had actually been up by 16.5% compared to average days, likely indicating that people were bored and randy. Pornhub traffic started to fluctuate after the GTA 6 launch and reached an average peak a few days later.

Thanks to the game's massive success, we're also seeing the Rule 34 effect on GTA 6, as Mashable's research noted a 16,196% spike in GTA-related searches. Up to 15 million search queries were made on November 18 alone, with users searching for GTA 6, the GTA 6 strip club, and content depicting the co-protagonist Lucia specifically. The fan-favorite stalker--and possible serial killer--Mandy also appeared in search results, while Lucia's partner-in-crime Jason ranked low.

Thursday Night Football also saw a big dip last week, with the lowest viewership of the season so far for a TNF game. While Rockstar's new open-world adventure can't be blamed entirely for that dip, it certainly must have had an impact, given that the football game was held on GTA 6's launch day. That effect didn't extend to the box office, as The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping opened to a massive $120 million in the US, almost triple that of the last film in the series, The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes.

For more GTA 6 news, you can read up on how modders are attempting to make an unofficial PC port, how to fix GTA 6's broken HDR, and you can check out our list of walkthroughs in the GTA 6 guides hub.

title: Thursday Night Football Had Lowest Viewership All Season On GTA 6 Launch Day
text:
The Thursday Night Football matchup on November 19, the day that GTA 6 came out, had the lowest viewership of the entire season so far for a TNF game, but the low ratings might not be due entirely to competition with GTA 6.

The data shows that 12.23 million people, on average, watched the November 19 matchup between the Indianapolis Colts and Houston Texans on Prime Video. That was a 9% slide from the Week 11 Thursday Night Football matchup in 2025 featuring the New England Patriots and New York Jets.

Looking at week-over-week, the November 12 matchup this year between the Washington Commanders and New York Giants drew 16.27 million viewers, and was up 17% compared to the Week 10 matchup in 2025 featuring the Las Vegas Raiders and Denver Broncos.

Due to the poor ratings of the November 19 TNF game, the full-season average now for TNF games this season sank to 16.62 million on per game.

One expert told GameSpot that live sports like football probably won't be too heavily impacted by GTA 6 because people want to watch in real time. The low ratings for the November 19 matchup could be partially attributable to competition with GTA 6, but a likelier scenario is that people tuned out because it was a boring game in which the heavily favored Texans throttled the Colts by a score of 26-3.

The Texans were up 17-3 at the half, and the game only had nine more points total scored in the second half--all by the Texans. Not exactly thrilling stuff that people would stay glued to.

Ahead of GTA 6's launch, people also wondered how The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, which released on November 20, might be impacted. It may have been, but the film still put up massive numbers at the box office that exceeded expectations.

GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies via pre-purchases alone and generated close to $4 billion on day one. The game will continue to sell, and it should get another jolt of sales when the PC edition arrives in 2027, as rumored.

title: GTA 6 Has A Secret Mission That Feels Like Hard Target Meets Saw
text:
In the mood for a little bloodsport? In GTA 6, you can teach one loud-mouthed hunter that Lucia (or Jason) is the deadliest game, as this secret mission will require cunning and sharp shooting to survive. It's Hard Target meets SAW, and the victor gets a pretty sizable stack of cash. Here's how you can be the most elusive of quarry.

Go to Hyde Island

Located north of Lummox County and the Moreau River, Hyde Island is where you can start this mission. All you have to do is land on the island, and after a few steps, a dart will hit you and knock you out.

Listen to your captor's speech

Now for the boring part. You'll wake up inside of a shipping container, with a fashionable explosive necklace locked in place. Once your captor finishes his rant, the game begins, and you'll want to move.

Run to the tent directly in front of you

You'll have 10 seconds to reach a tent in front of you, where you'll find a gun and a paltry two rounds for the sidearm. After the count is up, a hunter on a quad bike will show up, and he'll be gunning for you. To make things worse, he also has a dog with him that'll track you throughout the island. Don't engage him; he's heavily armored, and two bullets aren't nearly enough to stop him—besides, you'll need those rounds for his dog, Caesar. Sorry, animal lovers.

Search for more outposts

You can find more ammo, adrenaline, and a shotgun at nearby outposts. Each one is lit up, so be fast, be sneaky, and try not to get caught. The hunter is going to be tracking you constantly, even without his dog, and he has a sniper rifle that can take you out in just a few shots if he catches you.

Prepare for a showdown

Get as much ammo as you can, and choose your spot for the last stand. The hunter's dog will be a pest, so deal with it first. It's easy to spot, with a red light on its collar. Trees also make for good cover against the hunter, so once he's in range, start nailing him with shots to critical areas. Once he stumbles, unload a few shotgun rounds and finish him off.

Collect your rewards

Once the hunter is down, search his body for the Island-Poacher FF-50 sniper rifle and ammo for it. Head west to the boathouse to reclaim your personal items and $15,000 in cash. Not a bad haul for a deadly night's work.

What happens if you fail?

If the hunter does kill you, you'll lose a chunk of cash and wake up near one of your safehouses. The good news is you can retry the mission by heading back to Hyde Island, but the bad news is you'll have to listen to the hunter's speech again.

title: GTA 6 Players On PS5 Averaged 17+ Hours During First Weekend
text:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here, and it's breaking records everywhere, including at PlayStation.

The gaming giant has announced that GTA 6 is the "biggest launch in PlayStation history, a record that goes back 30+ years and five console generations. According to the gaming giant, more than 39 million unique players on PS5 have jumped into GTA 6 so far.

Here is a quick rundown of GTA 6's new records on PS5 so far (covering the November 19-22 period):

  • Highest number of concurrent players for any free or paid game on PlayStation, ahead of Fortnite, Call of Duty, and everything else.
  • Players collectively logged 683 million hours of GTA 6 at launch, with each player spending an average of 17.4 hours in the game's first few days.
  • GTA 6's launch led to the largest number of newly connected PS5 consoles on a single day since the system came out in 2020, and outside of the Christmas season.
  • GTA 6 was the first game played on 70% of new PS5 consoles, which suggests a lot of people bought a system specifically for GTA 6.

A big, record-breaking start for GTA 6 was always expected. If the game didn't break records, that would be a bigger story. Additionally, GTA 6 is an anomaly--its success will not save the AAA industry from its many serious, deep-rooted issues, experts have said, and many believe other publishers will learn all the wrong lessons.

GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies via pre-purchases alone and generated close to $4 billion on day one. The game will continue to sell, and it should get another jolt of sales when the PC edition arrives in 2027, as rumored.

title: Lego’s First Marvel Rivals Set Is A 495-Piece Tribute To The Game’s Most Adorable Terror
text:
Next month marks the second anniversary of Marvel Rivals, and to celebrate, a new Lego set is on the way that lets you build the game's unofficial mascot, Jeff the Land Shark. While we regularly see Lego Marvel sets roll out, this is the first-ever Marvel Rivals kit, and it'll go on sale starting January 1, 2027, priced at $50. GameSpot can also exclusively reveal the first images of Jeff below, showing the completed build alongside his box art.

See at The Lego Store

The 495-piece set captures the adorable strategist in all his glory, including his big eyes, toothy smile, huge tongue, and even his collar. This won't be a static figure either: once fully assembled, Jeff has a movable head, legs, tail, and fins that let builders recreate his joyful trot, swimming, and battle poses. For added touches, his collar includes his signature name tag, his tongue can be removed to close his mouth, and his fin can be detached so builders can replicate Jeff's Hide-and-Seek movement ability from the game.

"Jeff brings together everything players love about a breakout gaming character: an unforgettable silhouette, a personality you understand instantly, and the ability to turn any match into a story," Lego Marvel design lead Jesper C. Nielsen said in a press release. "We wanted this Lego model to capture both sides of him, from the lovable companion fans want beside their screen to the unpredictable strategist they meet in battle."

Meanwhile, Jeff and the rest of the Marvel Rivals roster are preparing to cap off an entire year of Avengers-centric events that have been building up to the game's big Avengers: Doomsday tie-in. Season 11.5 kicks off on December 11. Nightcrawler was recently added to the game, bringing mutant energy, swords, and teleportation strategies, and he'll soon be followed by Marvel's unique take on Dracula, who has spent the last few months hibernating and healing for the battles ahead.
